increment: Independent Futures order, fill and income history using official signed V3 read endpoints

sources.scope_note: Closes the separately tracked Futures history gap. Detailed endpoint fields and time/query limits come from official V3 documentation, not a claim that each field is an explicit PRD row. This is separate from user-deferred private BAPI statistics/Futures Summary/TWAP.

orders.symbol: optional exact symbol; blank means all symbols
orders.window: end-start strictly less than seven days
orders.retention: Canceled or expired orders with no fills and created more than seven days earlier are omitted by exchange; this does not apply to partially filled cancellations.
display: original/current type and UTC create/update time

trades.window: official maximum seven days; implementation uses less than seven days
trades.query_modes: Only symbol and time range; do not send fromId or orderId. Official fromId cannot combine with times; orderId takes precedence over other modes.
display: one row per fill ID, not one row per order
quoteQty and signed commission in commissionAsset
reported signed realizedPnl in original contract margin asset, separate from fee; no net aggregation

income.window: inclusive milliseconds; implementation also segments less than seven days
income.identity: incomeType + tranId, not globally unique tranId
display: safe type and copyable transaction reference
income.privacy: Do not expose raw info field

boundaries: Widget -> Riverpod controller -> signed repository -> existing AsterAccountService; immutable Decimal records at data boundary.
Current EOA/previously existing Privy wallet is both user and signer; chain1666 and shared microsecond nonces; never create replacement wallet/API signer.
Opening, filtering, local pagination, localization and lifecycle never sign/read automatically. One explicit read/continuation requests one batch; no retry or automatic second signature.
Latest time segment first. Saturated1000-row batches split inclusive halves with no gaps; at1ms mark truncated. This is manual time subdivision, not server page/cursor support.
Keep maximum10000 records; reject overflow preserving existing rows and pending work, advise narrower range. Local display pages contain10 rows and do not sign.

Deduplicate by symbol+orderId / symbol+fillId / incomeType+tranId; reject immutable conflicts, execution regressions and terminal status regressions. Newest valid order update wins; original type immutable when both known.

Public exchange metadata including inactive symbols only supplies original units; metadata failure preserves exact signed amounts with unknown units. Capture private response timestamp before metadata delay.

Failures retain successful records and query; 30second staleness, background/resume and account events mark old snapshots stale; segmented data is not atomic. No server-side completeness beyond actual returned/retained scope.
Auth ID/address/kind/signing changes clear private results; stop/back/disposal discard late responses. UTC custom end capped now. No persistent personal historical cache or financial write.
Real exchange acceptance and native behavior remain deferred; synthetic tests are not real account acceptance.
